title: Overlay tarballs lack source-controlled integrity verification
description: The overlay resolver accepts bytes when registry SHA-512 metadata is absent and returns existing cache files without verification before extraction. The intended registry trust root and cache-writer boundary are unknown.
claimed_root_cause: The overlay resolver trusts optional registry-provided integrity and unverified cached tarball bytes rather than a source-controlled digest.

trace.description: The builder obtains package metadata from a configured registry.
It fetches tarball bytes from the metadata URL.
The resolved tarball is extracted into the staged runtime tree.

evidence.description: The cache-hit branch returns existing bytes without verification.
The digest check is conditional on registry-provided dist.sha512.
The source manifest pins package names/versions but lacks a per-package tarball digest.

blockers: The required isolated registry fixture could not run because the OS-enforced sandbox is unavailable.
Source does not establish the intended registry integrity root or who can write the actual build worker cache before consumption.

validation_plan.local: In an approved network-denied sandbox with a stub registry and scratch-only cache, use a harmless dummy tarball and confirm whether omitted registry digest and cache-hit bytes are accepted and extracted. Do not use a real registry or publish artifacts.
validation_plan.deployment: Have the build owner confirm the documented integrity root and who can write any shared engine-overlay cache on actual build workers.
